groups.title: Ashok Leyland BS-IV / BS6 (Bosch EDC17 + SCR) — J1939 SPN/FMI codes (generic heavy-duty)
groups.source: SAE J1939-73 SPN/FMI generic definitions + ALSTI Ashok Leyland BS-IV training (H4/H6 iEGR, EDC17 CV54, SCR, DTC chapter — scribd) + Tata BS6 DEF codes 4334/3521 (video index) + Cummins/Detroit SCR TSBs (SPN 4334, 3364, 1761, 3361)

steps.ta: Ashok Leyland scan tool (J1939) மூலம் SPN + FMI படிக்கவும் — FMI = fault வகை (0 high, 1 low, 3/4 short, 5 open, 18 low-moderate, 31 condition).
SCR / DEF code-களுக்கு முதலில் DEF தரம் (refractometer 32.5 %), level, line crystallisation சோதிக்கவும்.
Air / EGR / fuel code-களை SCR code-க்கு முன் சரி செய்யவும் (NOx code-கள் அவற்றால் வரலாம்).

title.en: DEF (urea) pressure — FMI 16 too high / FMI 18 too low
DEF quality (urea concentration not 32.5 %)

causes.en: Contaminated / diluted DEF — test with refractometer (31–34 %)

title.en: DEF dosing unit / quality input (FMI 31 = DEF quality fault)
DEF tank level (low / very low → inducement)

causes.en: Low DEF level — refill; sender unit if inactive code persists

title.en: DEF dosing valve circuit (FMI 3 / 4 / 5)
DEF / SCR system fault (BS6 SCR)
SCR operator inducement — severe (derate)
Engine coolant temperature — high / low
Fuel rail pressure
J1939 CAN network communication
Battery voltage
EGR mass flow rate (FMI 18 = low)

groups.title: Ashok Leyland trucks — WABCO air-brake ABS blink codes (generic WABCO chart)
groups.source: WABCO / Meritor WABCO Maintenance Manual MM-0112 'Truck, Tractor and Bus ABS' blink-code diagnostics (manualshive: 1st digit / 2nd digit 1–6, system function 7: J1939, ATC valve, retarder relay) + WABCO C-version blink code chart (scribd). Ashok Leyland trucks use WABCO-type air ABS — confirm ECU version on vehicle.

steps.ta: Ignition ON, blink-code switch-ஐ 1 வினாடி அழுத்தி விடவும் → ABS lamp-ல் முதல் இலக்க flash, 1.5 வி இடைவெளி, இரண்டாம் இலக்க flash.
1-1 = fault இல்லை. மற்ற code-களுக்கு 2nd digit = எந்த சக்கரம் என்று பார்க்கவும்.
சரி செய்த பின் switch-ஐ 3 வினாடி அழுத்தி stored fault clear; 5 mph+ test drive செய்து lamp அணைகிறதா பார்க்கவும்.

title.en: No faults — system OK
ABS modulator valve fault (open / short in valve or cable). 2nd digit = location: 1 right steer (front), 2 left steer, 3 right drive, 4 left drive, 5 right additional, 6 left additional
Wheel speed sensor air gap too large (sensor out of adjustment). 2nd digit = location: 1 right steer (front), 2 left steer, 3 right drive, 4 left drive, 5 right additional, 6 left additional

causes.en: Push sensor fully against tone ring

title.en: Wheel speed sensor short or open circuit. 2nd digit = location: 1 right steer (front), 2 left steer, 3 right drive, 4 left drive, 5 right additional, 6 left additional
Wheel speed sensor signal erratic / intermittent. 2nd digit = location: 1 right steer (front), 2 left steer, 3 right drive, 4 left drive, 5 right additional, 6 left additional
Tyre size / tone-wheel mismatch between steer and drive axles. 2nd digit = location: 1 right steer (front), 2 left steer, 3 right drive, 4 left drive, 5 right additional, 6 left additional
System function — J1939 / CAN link, ATC valve, retarder relay (2nd digit identifies item)
ECU / power supply (voltage too low or high, internal fault)
